statement: GraphVarAlloc admits a polynomial-time O(log n) multiplicative approximation.
algorithm: For every k, greedily select min(4^k,n) variables with variance 4^-k and return the best level.
scope_audit: Executable core is zero-mean; paper's reduction invokes non-negative means. Runtime is polynomial in explicit input length.
verdict_rule: Require proof obligations, exhaustive small-domain checks, large scaling, independent quadrature, and a rejected fixed-order control.
